interface.description: Wireless interface to monitor. Leave empty for autodetection.

level_key.description: Single character key to toggle the level histogram screen.

scan_key.description: Single character key to toggle the scan window screen.

info_key.description: Single character key to toggle the info screen.

sort_order.description: Sorting criterion for the scan window (essid, signal, channel, mac, open).

sort_ascending.description: Sort scan results in ascending order.

scan_interval.description: Interval in seconds between scans in the scan window.

update_interval.description: Refresh rate of the main interface in centiseconds.
